# Phase 4 icon recomposition fixtures

Owner-approved Phase 4 final assets. Nine icons use the canonical finance badge ring plus recomposed inner content. `production.png` keeps the separately approved preserved-source cleanup result. Originals are frozen only to prove provenance and to ensure they cannot accidentally inherit the exact-hash runtime bypass.

The runtime does **not** reconstruct these icons. It only accepts exact canonical-path + SHA-256 registered files and presents them without destructive cleanup.
